entities.justification: Described as a minor ('pupillo') whose funds of 354 florins and 13.5 grossi are subject to administration.
Named as 'praefatam Albertam Leopoliensem', in whose hands curators deposited the burden from her person.
Adjectival and locational references to the city of Lwów ('Albertam Leopoliensem', 'Cives Leopolienses', 'ea Civitate').
Appears personally as 'Joannes Soszkiewic Traxifex', husband and guardian of Helizabeth Sarnkowna.
Spouse of Joannes Soszkiewicz, appearing through her husband and guardian to make an obligation.
